newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Nov 25.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Nov 25.

text.p: * Duke Power Co and PanEnergy Corp agreed to merge, creating an integrated energy company with a market capitalization of $23 billion. Duke will issue about $7.7 billion in stock to complete the deal, or 1.0444 shares for each PanEnergy share. Duke closed at 47-7/8 on Friday and PanEnergy closed at 42-1/4.

* Chevron Corp plans to end all offshore crude production in California within five years and may be forced to write down its interests there, the Wall Street Journal reported. Chevron closed at 67-3/8.

* Applied Materials Inc said it will buy two companies for $285 million. It will pay $175 million, or $18.50 per share, for Opal Inc, and $110 million for Orbot Instruments Ltd. Orbotech Ltd, which owns 1.2 million Opal shares, will realize an $8 million gain and has agreed to the deal. Applied Materials closed at 38-5/8. Opal closed at 12-1/8. Orbotech closed at 15.
* Chiron Corp said it will not pursue a product license application for its genital herpes vaccine after clinical trials failed to establish the vaccine's effectiveness. Shares closed at 21-7/8.
